name: undo-toast
title: Undo toast
description: The delete-with-undo pattern: the row goes at once, a toast offers Undo with a draining timer, and the real delete runs only when the time is up.
docs: Call toastUndo({ message, onUndo, onCommit }) from the handler that removes the row, after you have removed it from your own state. onUndo puts it back; onCommit runs once, when the six seconds are up, when the toast is closed or pushed out by a newer one, and when the page is left (make the request with keepalive or sendBeacon there). The line drains over duration and waits while the toast is hovered or has focus and while the tab is in the background. Mount Toaster once, as for any toast.
